Name: HERO_MENU_PARAM_ST
Description: Handles various visual information for Heros, such as appearances in menus and Visual Codex stats.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 6 of 10 heroes.

Fields.Name: Hero CharaInitParam ID
Fields.Description: CharaInitParam row of the hero this menu row belongs to; the menus find a hero's row by the hero of this CharaInitParam. Retail: 50000 + 100 x (hero - 1).

Fields.Name: Character Select Pose
Fields.Description: Animation the hero plays at hero selection. Retail: 99910-99919, one per hero.

Fields.Name: Character Select Camera ID
Fields.Description: HeroMenuCameraParam row used for the hero at hero selection (rows 1-3: tall, standard, short hero). Retail: 1-3.

Fields.Name: Change Garb Camera ID
Fields.Description: HeroMenuCameraParam row used for the hero in Change Garb (rows 4-6: tall, standard, short hero). Retail: 4-6.

Fields.Name: Change Garb Pose
Fields.Description: Animation the hero plays in Change Garb. Retail: 99920-99929, one per hero.

Fields.Name: HP Grade
Fields.Description: Letter grade for HP shown in the hero's menu stats (0 S, 1 A, 2 B, 3 C, 4 D, 5 E). Retail: 0-4.

Fields.Name: FP Grade
Fields.Description: Letter grade for FP shown in the hero's menu stats (0 S ... 5 E). Retail: 1-4.

Fields.Name: Stamina Grade
Fields.Description: Letter grade for stamina shown in the hero's menu stats (0 S ... 5 E). Retail: 1-4.

Fields.Name: Strength Grade
Fields.Description: Letter grade for Strength shown in the hero's menu stats (0 S ... 5 E). Retail: 0-4.

Fields.Name: Dexterity Grade
Fields.Description: Letter grade for Dexterity shown in the hero's menu stats (0 S ... 5 E). Retail: 0-4.

Fields.Name: Intelligence Grade
Fields.Description: Letter grade for Intelligence shown in the hero's menu stats (0 S ... 5 E). Retail: 0-4.

Fields.Name: Faith Grade
Fields.Description: Letter grade for Faith shown in the hero's menu stats (0 S ... 5 E). Retail: 0-4.

Fields.Name: Arcane Grade
Fields.Description: Letter grade for Arcane shown in the hero's menu stats (0 S ... 5 E). Retail: 0-3.
